title: Discord server
subtitle: Preview and load of the Decatron server template
loadFailed: The template could not be loaded.

guide.title: How to use it
guide.intro: The template describes the whole server (roles, channels, permissions and texts). First you see a preview of what would be done and, if you like it, you load it. Loading only creates and fills in: it never deletes or renames anything, and it can be repeated without duplicating.
guide.step1: Create the «Decatron» server with your personal account (with two-factor authentication) and open the server settings.
guide.step2: Invite the bot with the Administrator link (Community requires it). Afterwards you can remove that permission from the bot's role.
guide.step3: Copy the server id (Discord settings → Advanced → Developer mode → right-click the server → Copy ID).
guide.step4: Paste the id, choose what you want done and press «Preview».
guide.step5: Review the list. If it looks right, type the server name and press «Load».
guide.step6: When it finishes, preview again: it should say there is nothing left to do. The manual steps below are done in Discord.

form.title: Server and options
form.guildIdHint: Numbers only, 17 to 20 digits. The bot must be inside the server.
form.optSettingsHint: Verification level, content filter, notifications, AFK channel and system channel. It changes settings that already exist.
form.optCommunityHint: Needed for forums, the stage and announcement channels. It requires the bot to be Administrator.
form.optMessagesHint: Welcome, guide, verification and rules, in Spanish and English, and pins them.
form.optAutomodHint: Spam, mass mentions, Discord word lists and invites to other servers.

detail.guild.name_differs: The server is called «{{a0}}» and the template is for «{{a1}}» (it is not renamed).
detail.role.create_limited: Created without these permissions, which the bot doesn't have: {{a0}}.
detail.role.adopt: Already exists with that name: linked without touching it.
detail.role.bot_not_found: The bot's role was not found: invite it and preview again.
detail.role.blocked_perm: The bot has no permission to manage roles.
detail.role.order: Placed right below the bot's role, in the template's order.
detail.role.order_unknown: The bot's role was not found: the order will be done by hand.
detail.channel.adopt: Already exists with that name: linked without touching it.
detail.channel.blocked_perm: The bot has no permission to manage channels.
detail.channel.blocked_community: Needs Community: turn it on and load again.
detail.channel.convert: Changes from a text channel to an announcement channel.
detail.channel.create_as_text: Created as text and becomes announcements when Community is turned on.
detail.community.blocked_admin: Turning on Community requires the bot to be Administrator (you can remove it afterwards).
detail.community.enable: Turned on with the template's rules and updates channels.
detail.message.blocked: The channel cannot be created yet.
detail.automod.blocked: The Manage Server permission is needed.
detail.automod.manual_empty: No words yet: filled in when each language opens.
detail.manual.give_admin: Give the Administrator permission to the Creator role by hand (the bot can't grant it).
detail.manual.move_roles: Drag the team roles above the bot's role: the bot can't place them higher than itself.
detail.manual.role_styles: Gradient and holographic (Creator, Fundador, Premium) once there are 3 boosts.
detail.manual.onboarding: Set up by hand with the template's values. Discord requires 7 default channels visible to everyone and at least 5 where @everyone can write: with member-only channels that isn't met yet.
detail.manual.screening: Discord doesn't allow setting up the rules screening through the API: turn it on by hand with the template's rules.
detail.manual.step1: Create the «Decatron» server with your personal account (the API doesn't hand servers over to a bot safely) and turn on two-factor authentication.
detail.manual.step2: Invite the bot: with Administrator for the first load (turning on Community requires it) and afterwards remove that permission from the bot's role or use the minimal-permissions link.
detail.manual.step3: Upload the icon, the banner (boost level 2) and the description; the custom URL needs level 3.
detail.manual.step4: Have a native speaker review the names and tags of the unreviewed languages before turning them on.
detail.manual.step5: Link the server to the Decatron panel (Settings → Integrations → Discord) and link the level roles by name with the XP bot's.
detail.manual.step6: Turn on Onboarding and the rules screening by hand (the two manual steps above) and test the flow with a test account.
detail.community.update_channels: The Community rules and updates channels are reassigned to the template's (they must be text channels).
detail.channel.require_tag: «Require a tag» is turned on in the forum (Discord doesn't allow it when creating it).

apply.title: Load
apply.intro: Type the server's name exactly as it appears in Discord to confirm it is the right one.
apply.failed: There were errors. Review the list and preview again.
apply.hasBlocked: Some steps are blocked: the rest will be loaded.
